testgen.claim: 75% of target test classes had at least one generated test that built; 57% had one that also passed; 25% had one that also increased coverage. These are cumulative class-level yields, not percentages of individual generated tests.
testgen.separate_cohort: In separate Instagram/Facebook test-a-thons, engineers accepted 73% of recommendations; 11.5% of all classes to which the tool was applied were improved.
testgen.limit: The cohorts and denominators differ. Neither acceptance rate is a predicted result for a bank pilot.
